payload.body_they: {{Name}} may be drawn to people who make life feel larger by introducing them to ideas, experiences, beliefs, or possibilities they would not have reached alone. Another person's knowledge can genuinely expand their worldview. The complication begins when that person's confidence starts carrying more authority than {{Name}}'s own judgment. Someone can be inspiring and experienced without automatically knowing what is right for them.
